what: The author review queue (Comparison Principles Codex C3, shaped by C3(a) / R6-54). A verifier ACCEPT that carries doubt — any dissenting vote among its replicates, or ACCEPT_WITH_CAVEAT at a PARTIAL floor — is recorded here instead of being refused by code. A queued item is HELD: the packet builder gives it no seat and the emit step refuses to publish it, until the author records an author_ruling of ADMIT or REFUSE.

doubt.DISSENTING_VOTE: any replicate whose verdict class differs from the majority's
doubt.ACCEPT_WITH_CAVEAT_AT_PARTIAL: the final verdict is ACCEPT_WITH_CAVEAT and the final floor is PARTIAL
